decisions.reason: Message 179 already has a complete candidate MODIFY establishing selection of substantive lessons, stories, or real points; the narrative-completeness change requires no additional update.
The narrative-completeness change does not alter permitted source material, and the separate source-selection clause in message 179 is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY.
Requiring a complete standalone lesson, story, or point does not change the required caption font.
The narrative-completeness standard does not change or resume the deferred one-clip trial-batch obligation.
The requirement to select and shape a complete narrative moment does not modify clean-editing style or prohibited visual treatments.
The separate 70-85 second duration change in message 179 is already represented by a complete same-message MODIFY; the narrative-completeness update requires no further duration change.
The narrative-completeness change does not alter the white-text-only or no-text-effects standards.
A complete standalone lesson, story, or point does not logically change the independent hook-selection criterion.
The narrative-completeness change does not alter the existing target of 140 client-approved clips or its approval-counting rules.
Changing the required narrative content of clips does not modify which posted-clip performance metrics are tracked.
The narrative-completeness standard does not change the dedicated Instagram account's type, assignment, or posting purpose.
